title: MY BATMAN, MY FAVOURITE PERSON. 🦇❤️
introMessage: I made you a secret little corner of Gotham. No villains to chase tonight—just a few things I wanted you to keep.
introNote: You can be the hero for everyone else tomorrow. Tonight, come sit beside me. I saved the softest page, the good spot on the rooftop, and at least one very dramatic kiss.
letter:
Hey, my Batboy,

I wanted to make you a little place that feels like ours—a hideout from the noise, with a few things I never want to forget and a letter you can open whenever you need me close.

What I love most is the way an ordinary day gets softer when you're in it: the little jokes, the quiet comfort, and that feeling of being on the same side. I hope this tiny scrapbook feels a bit like a hug from me.

So when Gotham gets loud, come find me. I'll be the girl in black on the rooftop, saving you a seat and pretending I don't already know you're my favourite.

All my love, and one kiss I am absolutely not taking back,
Your Catwoman
dialogue: And who needs me, then? Hm? 💋

reasons.back: I like that we don't have to fill every second.
Half the fun is knowing exactly why we're laughing.
Being on your side feels like the easiest choice.
A normal day gets a little golden when it's ours.
It keeps turning out to be right beside you.
I still get a tiny thrill thinking about more us.

gallery.caption: The city can wait. I like it up here with you.
Proof that soft things can be a little bit fearless.
A whole city below. My favourite person beside me.

scrapSecret: Official Gotham notice: your heart is under new management. Mine. ♡
batSecret: If you ever need me, no signal needed. One message and I'm already on my way.
catSecret: Purr-sonal note: I stole your heart. I'm keeping it. You can have mine. 💋
finalMessage: If you made it all the way here: I still have a crush on you. That's the whole secret. See you on the next page, my love.
